items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Mrs. Francis Oliver ... Fetice. F-E-L. No. I-C-E. That's exactly it. Fetice.

ctx.x: Yeah. Your grand—great-grandmother's first name, the Mimi, what was that first name? How do you spell it?
Fetice. F-E-L. No. I-C-E. That's exactly it. Fetice. Yes. Because you see, you've got a hyphen over those E's. It's too childish.
Yes. Because the first name, because I wasn't the—I tried to guess at the name like that. I may not use that material either, but in case—I did want to mention what the grandmother—
